# Public-tree hygiene rules, enforced by tools/ci/check-public-hygiene.sh
# (the "Public-tree hygiene gate" CI job). This repository is public, so the
# tracked tree must stay free of private-infrastructure and private-process
# vocabulary. One rule per line:
#
#   <grep-flags><TAB><extended-regex pattern>
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Flags are a subset of
# grep's: E (extended regex, required) and i (case-insensitive).
#
# Rule classes (one rule per line below, in this order):
#   decision-ids    internal decision-record references
#   runner-labels   private CI runner-pool label scheme
#   dev-repo slugs  pre-publication development repository names
#   internal IDs    internal work-item / requirement identifiers
#   fleet topology  private build-fleet host, machine and topology words
#
# The slug and topology rules use explicit non-word character classes rather
# than \b, so a longer path segment (github.com/oschaaf/cyclone-foo) is not a
# hit while a hyphenated compound (non-self-hosted) still is.
E	ADR-[0-9]{3}([^0-9]|$)
Ei	(linux|mac|macos|windows)-(x64|arm64)(-[a-z0-9]+)*-(pool|mps[0-9]+)([^a-z0-9-]|$)
E	(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_/-])(oschaaf/modpagespeed-2|oschaaf/cyclone|mod_pagespeed_private)([^A-Za-z0-9_/-]|$)
E	MPS2-[A-Z]+-[0-9]+
Ei	(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])(self-hosted|threadripper|duster|mpb-?16|weamp-web)([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)
